name: Globloom
subtitle: Fuse orbs, tame the tide
shortDescription: Slide, aim and drop sea-glass orbs into a golden globe. Twins fuse into bigger orbs, and every one of ten worlds bends the rules: pegs, tides, urchins, ice...
longDescription:
A golden-rimmed globe floats above a sunlit lagoon. Slide to aim, lift your finger to let a glass orb fall, and watch twins of the same size fuse into the next size up. Grow the goal orb before the drops run out and before the pile creeps over the tide mark.

### Ten Worlds, Ten Twists
Each world of ten levels changes how the globe behaves. Sunny Shallows teaches the fusing. Pearl Pegs scatters pearls that orbs bounce off. Tidal Tilt rocks the whole sea so the pile slides. Urchin Reef sends spiky urchins that pop everything beside them. Frost Cove brings frosted orbs that stay inert until a fusion nearby thaws them. Prism Bay hands you prisms that lift any orb one size. Whirlpool turns a current through the water, Magnet Shoal pulls orbs toward a pink pearl, Rising Tide lowers the tide mark with every drop, and Grand Lagoon stacks the lot. 100 levels in all, each with three stars to chase.

### A New Tide Every Day
The Daily Tide serves the same twisted globe to everyone on that date and keeps a streak of the days you play it. Deep Dive is the calm alternative: no goal, no budget, just stacking and fusing for as high a score as you can reach.

### Tools When You Need Them
Swap the orb in your hand with the one waiting next. If the globe overflows you can watch an optional video to pop the seven smallest orbs and carry on, or to earn three extra drops when you run out. Nothing about the puzzles is ever sold.

### The Reef Cabinet
Every level, Daily and Deep Dive run pays out coins that cost nothing and come only from playing. Spend them on 24 collectible charms, from the Sun Disc to the Grand Pearl, and wear one as a gem on the globe's rim. Fixed prices, no random draws.

### Bright, Quiet, Offline
Daylight lagoons, glossy 3D glass and soft chimes you can switch off, plus a reduce-motion setting. It works without a connection.

### Free To Play
Globloom is free, with ads: a banner on the home screen, a banner below the globe and a short full-screen break after some levels. Watch optional videos to earn ad-free play for the month, or subscribe to Globloom Ad-free for a monthly price shown in the store. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in your App Store account settings.
